Uses the MSTR, MSTX and STRC boxes in WHAT IF as the starting point. MSTX is a 2x daily fund. For today's date it is twice the day's move off yesterday's closes, the same formula as WHAT IF. For a later date it is MSTX now x (MSTR ratio) squared, less decay at 75% MSTR vol. Best estimate: projected plus today's gap, fading by half every 28 days.
